headline: Hardin-Simmons finishes ASC play unbeaten
dek: Hardin-Simmons closed the campaign with thirteen wins, three draws, and two losses across all matches, never dropping a league contest. Mary Hardin-Baylor stayed closest through the schedule, while the rest of the conference finished well back.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Attacking production in the ASC splits sharply between the top tier and the lower half: Hardin-Simmons scored 56 goals across all matches, more than East Texas Baptist, Howard Payne, and Schreiner combined.

wire.line: ASC programs won sixteen, drew five, and lost fourteen outside the conference, scoring 65 goals and allowing 46.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two August matches remain past their scheduled date with no published result: McMurry at Texas Permian Basin and Howard Payne against Lubbock Christian.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Tatum Barnett contributed nine goals and ten assists on 48 shots for Hardin-Simmons.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: East Texas Baptist goalkeeper Taylor Lauster made 108 saves while allowing 30 goals across the season, posting a 0.783 save percentage and three shutouts.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mary Hardin-Baylor scored 33 goals and conceded fifteen across all matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: McMurry had at least fourteen different players score across the season.

last_match.line: The defeat ended Mary Hardin-Baylor's unbeaten stretch since mid-October and gave Trinity a season sweep of the matchup.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
